analysis:
Only CHANGELOG.md head text was supplied (lines 233-600). No code, patch hunks or base text were available, so these claims are unverified documentation. No finding is raised because documentation alone creates no security regression.

Security claims to verify in the code passes:
- Frozen legacy MDM cohort (lines 262-273, TB-009 and TB-011, T-036, T-052, T-054). Check the /v1/enroll Bearer token plus SE-key proof, the 5-minute proof window, and gating of identity recovery, scheduling and cached trust. Check that noncohort owner self/prefer routing requires App Attest at final handoff, and that base rewards need macOS 27+ with the same qualified App Attest authorization (T-055).
- Provider-bound body minimization (line 244, A-001, T-003, T-051). Top-level user, metadata, safety_identifier and prompt_cache_key are stripped. Nested content is not anonymized, and authenticated account ownership and cache controls must be preserved.
- Cache-attempt bookkeeping and routing persistence (lines 245, 252 and 438-442, T-041). Check tenant isolation, epoch fencing and persisted holder rows. The changelog says no prompts, raw chain hashes or memory-tier holders are persisted.
- Line 536 states the T-031 earnings endpoint was removed (404). Line 538 states attestation challenges fail closed without status_signature. Line 540 states App Attest serves protocol 3 only.
- Line 532 states EIGENINFERENCE_MIN_PROVIDER_VERSION now excludes providers that report no version. This is a manual production-env step (/etc/d-inference/env).
- Line 498-: lines 408-413 and 561 describe default-on MiMo wired residency, rectangular MTP and a raised SSD TTL (30 minutes). The SEC-035 re-acceptance of that TTL needs checking against T-041.
- Cached prompt pricing (lines 513-519). Check that cached_tokens is provider-reported and billing-relevant: a malicious provider could overstate it, and lines 513-517 say malformed reports bill at full price.

Coverage limit: the next pass should examine the corresponding Go/Swift sources if supplied.
